units.source: Hidden Notes
units.context: Hidden Notes

units.source: For easy extensibility, a lot of features in Trilium make use of actual notes to store information as opposed to having them stored in a separate location in the database. This allows some functions such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Attributes__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Relations__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or even __TRILIUM_PH_4__Search__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Links__TRILIUM_PH_7__ to be able to operate on them.
units.context: Hidden Notes

units.source: As the name suggests, these notes are hidden to the user by default to prevent cluttering the note tree and to prevent them from being accidentally deleted.
units.context: Hidden Notes

units.source: The hidden notes are stored in the user's __TRILIUM_PH_0__Database__TRILIUM_PH_1__ just like normal notes, but they have a unique __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note ID__TRILIUM_PH_3__ which allows them to be distinguished from the normal ones.
units.context: Hidden Notes

units.source: Accessing the hidden note tree__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Accessing the hidden note tree

units.source: From the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__, select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Hidden notes__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Accessing the hidden note tree

units.source: Contents of the hidden note tree__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Here is a brief summary of all the notes within the hidden tree:
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Note
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Description
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Map__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This note is actually opened when the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ feature that is accessed from the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: It is possible to create any child notes in it without any additional meaning. For example, it can be used to store a list of note maps which can be linked to from other notes or __TRILIUM_PH_0__bookmarked__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__SQL Console History__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: When SQL queries or commands are executed in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__SQL Console__TRILIUM_PH_1__, they are stored here, grouped by month. Only the query is stored and not the results.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section can be accessed without going to the hidden tree by simply going to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and selecting Advanced → SQL console history.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Notes can be added as children of this tree, but it's generally not recommended to do so to not interfere with the normal history process.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Search History__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Whenever a search is executed from the full __TRILIUM_PH_0__Search__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the query will be stored here, grouped by month. Only the search parameters are stored and not the results themselves.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section can be accessed without going to the hidden tree by simply going to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and selecting Advanced → Search history.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Notes can be added as children of this tree, but it's generally not recommended to do so to not interfere with the normal history process.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Bulk Action__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section is used for __TRILIUM_PH_0__Bulk Actions__TRILIUM_PH_1__. The last configuration for bulk actions will be stored as part of this note, each action in its own __TRILIUM_PH_2__ label.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Notes can be added as children of this tree, but there won't be any benefit in doing so.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Backend Log__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This note corresponds to the backend log feature (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Error logs__TRILIUM_PH_1__).
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This item can be accessed without going to the hidden try by going to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and selecting Advanced → Backend log.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__User Hidden__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section can be used by __TRILIUM_PH_0__scripts__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to create their own notes that should not be directly visible to the user. The note can be identified by scripts by its unique ID: __TRILIUM_PH_2__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar Templates__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section contains the templates for the creation of launchers in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__. It is not possible to create child notes here.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Theoretically some of the notes here can be customized, but there's not much benefit to be had in doing so.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Shared Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This tree lists all of the notes that are __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared__TRILIUM_PH_1__ publicly. It can be useful to track down which notes are shared regardless of their position in the note tree.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section can be accessed without going to the hidden tree simply by going to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and selecting __TRILIUM_PH_2__Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Shared notes__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Sub-notes cannot be created here.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: The tree contains both available and displayed items of the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section can be accessed without going to the hidden tree by:
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Going to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and selecting __TRILIUM_PH_2__Configure launch bar…__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Right-clicking an empty space on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and selecting __TRILIUM_PH_2__Configure launch bar…__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Sub-notes cannot be created here.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section stores the list of __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This section can be accessed without going to the hidden tree by:
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Going to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and selecting __TRILIUM_PH_2__Options__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Pressing the dedicated Options icon in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This is very similar to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__, but is dedicated for the mobile UI only.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: Accessing it outside the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is the same as the Launch Bar, but needs to be done so from the mobile interface.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__User Guide__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree

units.source: This is where the User Guide appears in the note tree. Its notes are not stored in the database: Trilium builds them from files that ship with the application each time it starts, so they cannot be edited, moved or cloned, and they are not synchronized.
units.context: Hidden Notes > Contents of the hidden note tree
